# Synthetic Sample Medical Records

This directory contains synthetic, fictional medical records used exclusively for demonstrating and testing the Patient Medical Document Search System.

**Important Data Privacy Notice**:
All documents generated or stored in this directory are 100% synthetic and fictional. No real patient data, identifiable health information, or proprietary hospital records are included.

### Files generated by `backend/seed_demo_data.py`:
- `PAT1001_Medical_History.txt`: Demonstrates TXT extraction, multi-occurrence allergy history, and medication terms.
- `PAT1001_Allergy_Assessment.pdf`: Demonstrates multi-page PDF extraction (Pages 1 and 2), allergy test results, and follow-up recommendations.
- `PAT1001_Discharge_Summary.docx`: Demonstrates DOCX paragraph extraction, blood pressure monitoring, and discharge notes.
- `PAT1002_Previous_Treatment.txt`: Demonstrates outpatient hypertension and diabetes treatment notes.
- `PAT1002_Laboratory_Report.pdf`: Demonstrates multi-page PDF biochemistry and lipid panel results.
- `PAT1003_Consultation_Notes.docx`: Demonstrates pulmonary infection consultation notes.
